mainEntity.name: How is the student-loan line calculated?

acceptedAnswer.text: The same monthly PAYE rule as the UK student loan calculator: the plan rate × pay above the monthly threshold, rounded down to the nearest pound, then × 12 for the year.

mainEntity.name: How does Marriage Allowance work here?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your spouse or civil partner transfers £1,260 of their personal allowance to you, your tax bill falls by up to £252 (20% of £1,260). You must be a basic-rate taxpayer (or starter, basic or intermediate rate in Scotland) to receive it.

mainEntity.name: Is this the same as the paycheck calculator?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The paycheck calculator uses a US-style tax rate you type. This page uses the published 2026/27 UK bands.

mainEntity.name: Is this exactly what PAYE will take this month?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It uses annualised bands, not a cumulative payroll run, so a real month can differ by a few pounds.
